metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1943 · Casablanca
metas.description: A cynical expatriate American cafe owner struggles to decide whether or not to help his former lover and her fugitive husband escape the Nazis in French Morocco.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1940 · The Great Dictator
metas.description: Dictator Adenoid Hynkel tries to expand his empire while a poor Jewish barber tries to avoid persecution from Hynkel's regime.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1939 · Gone with the Wind
metas.description: A sheltered and manipulative Southern belle and a roguish profiteer face off in a turbulent romance as the society around them crumbles with the end of slavery and is rebuilt during the Civil War and Reconstruction periods.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1946 · The Best Years of Our Lives
metas.description: Three traumatized or physically disabled World War II veterans return home to the American Midwest to discover that they and their families have been irreparably changed making readjustment difficult.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1930 · All Quiet on the Western Front
metas.description: A German youth eagerly enters World War I, but his enthusiasm wanes as he gets a firsthand view of the horror.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1942 · To Be or Not to Be
metas.description: During the German occupation of Poland, an acting troupe becomes embroiled in a Polish soldier's efforts to track down a German spy.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1937 · Grand Illusion
metas.description: During WWI, two French soldiers are captured and imprisoned in a German P.O.W. camp. Several escape attempts follow until they are eventually sent to a seemingly inescapable fortress.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1945 · Rome, Open City
metas.description: During the Nazi occupation of Rome in 1944, the Resistance leader, Giorgio Manfredi, is chased by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a way to escape.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1944 · Lifeboat
metas.description: Several survivors of a torpedoed merchant ship in World War II find themselves in the same lifeboat with one of the crew members of the U-boat that sank their ship.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1942 · Saboteur
metas.description: A young man accused of sabotage goes on the run to prove his innocence.
